_why: docs/specs/ records what each delivery SPECIFIED, not what the code does now. Its stale flags, env vars and paths are the point: rewriting them to match today's tree would falsify the record of what was asked for. Drift in every other doc is a defect and stays reported. engines/chatterbox-shared/requirements.txt is generated by pip-tools; its one long line is not prose. docs/http-api.md and docs/tuning.md each cite third-party flags this repo does not own (curl's --form-string, llama-server's --cache-idle-slots/--cache-ram) that flag-drift cannot tell from engined's own. src/ggufMetadata.ts:5 cites an upstream GGUF-format URL ending in gguf.md, which path-drift misreads as a repo-relative path.
